row.evidence: Cofense's Recipient Sync terms say customers "connect its user directory service to push data to Cofense PhishMe" as an opt-in, non-standard feature, without naming the protocol; SCIM is not documented on any public Cofense page.
row.notes: Quote-only: no public pricing (cofense.com/pricing redirects to the home page; 'Request a Demo' only). PhishMe Enterprise supports SAML 2.0 SSO on request to Support; Cofense LMS also supports SAML2. PhishMe Recipient Sync (opt-in, non-standard, consent required) pulls recipients pushed from the customer's user directory every few hours, but the public page does not say whether it is SCIM, and the product docs at support.cofense.com require a customer login, so status stays unknown. The Okta OIN 'PhishMe' app is SWA only.

plans.name: Cofense PhishMe Enterprise

scim.notes: Not determinable: Cofense's help centre (support.cofense.com) requires a login. The public Recipient Sync terms say the customer's user directory pushes data to PhishMe, but do not say whether this is SCIM.

okta.notes: OIN 'PhishMe' app (last updated 2015) has only SWA checked (read from page markup).

entra.notes: No Microsoft Learn tutorial found (cofense-tutorial, phishme-tutorial and provisioning variants return 404).
